intg.api_off: The data API is switched off for this organization (System Settings › API and webhooks).
intg.calls_hint: Newest first. Tokens and signatures are masked and sensitive fields hidden.
intg.deliveries_hint: Newest first. Signatures and header values are masked and sensitive fields hidden. Open a delivery to see it or send it again.
intg.form_gone: a form you can no longer see
intg.headers_hint: Sent with every delivery. Values are stored encrypted and never shown again; leave a value empty to keep the saved one.
intg.inbound_active_desc: When off, calls to the address are refused.
intg.inbound_delete_text: Calls to its address will be refused. Its call log is kept.
intg.inbound_empty_text: Until one is added, other systems can reach records only through the data API.
intg.inbound_intro: Each endpoint is an address other systems post JSON to, creating or updating records of one form under the same rules as the application.
intg.inbound_kind: Callers prove who they are with
intg.inbound_secret_text: Give this secret to the sending system now. It is not shown again; if it is lost, replace it.
intg.inbound_subtitle: The address, who may call it, and how the JSON becomes a record.
intg.kind_hint.api: The caller sends a personal API token with write access to this form; records are saved as the token's owner.
intg.kind_hint.webhook: The sender signs the body with a shared secret; records are saved as the user chosen below.
intg.log_empty_incoming: Calls appear here once another system posts to this address.
intg.log_empty_outgoing: Deliveries appear here once a chosen event happens or a test is sent.
intg.mapping_hint: Where each field's value is in the JSON body, as a dot path such as order.customer.name. A field left empty is not changed.
intg.mapping_no_form_text: Its fields appear here to map.
intg.match_hint: A single text or number field; map it below.
intg.my_tokens_empty_text: Make one when a program needs to reach your records.
intg.my_tokens_intro: A token lets a program read or change records as you, on the forms you choose, through the data API (/api/v1/data). Its description is at /api/v1/openapi.json.
intg.name: Name
intg.operation_name.upsert: Updates a record, or creates one
intg.records_hint: Update and either find the record by a field the body always carries; a change saved meanwhile is a conflict, never overwritten.
intg.resend_failed: It could not be sent again.
intg.rotate_failed: The secret could not be replaced.
intg.rotate_inbound_text: The sender must use the new secret: calls signed with the old one will be refused.
intg.rotate_text: The receiver must be given the new secret: deliveries signed with it will not match the old one.
intg.run_as_hint: Their permissions, field access and record access apply. Choosing someone else needs Manage permissions.
intg.secret_text: Copy this secret now. It is not shown again; if it is lost, replace it.
intg.signature_hint: The header that carries the HMAC of the raw body, as hex, optionally prefixed with sha256= or sha512=.
intg.signing_hint: Receivers check X-LCF-Signature: sha256= the HMAC of the X-LCF-Timestamp value, a dot and the body, made with this secret.
intg.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; unique across the system.
intg.subtitle: Send record events to other systems, let other systems create and update records, and see every API token in use.
intg.target_hint: The host must be on the egress allowlist (System Settings). Private and internal addresses are always refused.
intg.token_access_hint: Only forms you can see are listed; write needs permission to add, change or delete records.
intg.token_failed: The token could not be made.
intg.token_ips_hint: Optional: IP addresses or ranges such as 203.0.113.0/24, one per line.
intg.token_name_hint: What uses it, so you can recognise it later.
intg.token_revoke_failed: The token could not be revoked.
intg.token_revoke_text: Programs using “{name}” stop working at once.
intg.token_secret_text: Copy it now and keep it secret: it is not shown again. Send it as Authorization: Bearer followed by the token.
intg.tokens_empty_text: People make their own tokens from their profile.
intg.tokens_intro: Every personal API token of the organization. Revoking one stops it at once.
intg.webhook_active_desc: When off, no events are sent; nothing is queued for later.
intg.webhook_delete_text: No more events are sent. Its delivery log is kept.
intg.webhook_form_hint: Leave empty to send events of every form.
intg.webhook_subtitle: What is sent, where, and how failures are retried.
intg.webhooks_empty_text: Until one is added, no record event leaves the system by webhook.
intg.webhooks_intro: Each webhook posts chosen record events to an address on the egress allowlist, signed with its own secret.
sync.active_desc: When off, the schedule does not start runs.
sync.conflicts_hint: What happens when a row matches a record that already exists.
sync.cron_hint: Minute, hour, day, month, weekday; for example 0 2 * * * for every night at two.
sync.delete_failed: The sync job could not be deleted
sync.delete_text: Its schedule and run history are removed. Records it wrote stay.
sync.dry_started: Dry run started; nothing will be saved or sent
sync.editor_subtitle: Records are written through the same rules, validation, workflow and audit as the interface, as the run-as user.
sync.empty_text: Keep a form in step with an external system: import its rows, or send your records to it.
sync.intro: Scheduled or on-demand import from a data source into a form, or export of a form's records to an address.
sync.mapping_hint.export: Name the property each field is sent as; use dots for nested objects, such as customer.name.
sync.mapping_hint.import: Choose what each field takes from the source, and tick the fields that identify a record.
sync.pick_first: Choose the data source and the form first
sync.pick_first_text: The fields of the form appear here once both are chosen.
sync.rule_desc.newest_wins: The record is updated when the source row changed after it.
sync.rule_desc.skip: Existing records are kept; only new rows create records.
sync.rule_desc.source_wins: The source's values replace the record's.
sync.rule_desc.target_wins: Only fields the record leaves empty are filled.
sync.run_as_hint: Records are read and written with this person's permissions.
sync.runs_hint: The last 50 runs, with a log of every row.
sync.save_failed: The sync job could not be saved
sync.schedule_hint: Leave empty to run only on demand.
sync.target_hint: Each record changed since the last successful run is sent as JSON, with the data source's authentication. The address must be on the egress allowlist.
sync.updated_from: Source column with the last change
sync.updated_from_hint: A date and time, such as 2026-05-01T10:00:00Z.
xds.active_desc: When off, its options are not offered and new values cannot be checked.
xds.auth_hint: Secrets are kept encrypted and are write-only.
xds.body_hint: Use {'{{'}q{'}}'} and {'{{'}depends{'}}'} as whole values; they are filled in as JSON strings.
xds.cache_desc.none: Every list and every save calls the source.
xds.cache_desc.stale_while_revalidate: Expired results are still used while fresh ones are fetched in the background.
xds.cache_desc.ttl: Results are reused until they expire.
xds.cache_hint: How long results are kept before the source is called again.
xds.columns_hint: Shown in record panels and available to sync jobs.
xds.db_hint: Connections are defined in the server environment, so no database password is stored here. Use an account that may only read the views it needs.
xds.delete_failed: The data source could not be deleted
xds.delete_text: Forms, panels and sync jobs must stop using it first.
xds.editor_subtitle: Calls go through the egress gateway; secrets are never shown again after saving.
xds.empty_text: Register a REST endpoint or a database view to offer its values in forms.
xds.intro: REST endpoints and database views that feed choice fields, record panels and sync jobs like a collection.
xds.mapping_hint.rest: Paths inside each record, such as code or address.city.
xds.no_connections_text: Ask the server administrator to define one with LCF_EXTERNAL_DB_CONNECTIONS.
xds.query_hint: Added to the address on every call.
xds.records_hint: The path to the list in the response, such as data.items; empty when the response is the list.
xds.rest_hint: The address must be on the egress allowlist. {'{'}q{'}'} and {'{'}depends{'}'} in the address or parameters are replaced by the search text and the parent value.
xds.save_failed: The data source could not be saved
xds.test_after_save_text: It can be tested once saved.
xds.test_hint: Calls the source now with the saved settings, without the cache.
xds.test_rows: {n} records read; the first ones as mapped:
xds.view_hint: The view's name, checked against the connection when saved.
